stem.text: A beach-ball falls vertically from a high hotel window. Air resistance is **not** negligible.
Which graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the acceleration $a$ of the ball?

A.alt: Graph of acceleration a against time t, with a line starting at the origin and rising.

B.alt: Graph of acceleration a against time t, with a horizontal line at a constant positive value.

C.alt: Graph of acceleration a against time t, with a curve starting at a positive value on the a axis and falling to zero.

D.alt: Graph of acceleration a against time t, with a curve starting at the origin, rising and levelling off at a positive value.
